notes: A run of a built-in under an overlay, driven through the state writer rather than written by hand: the graph is resolved from the shipped research workflow plus the research-tuned overlay, frozen, and then advanced one node at a time to completion. It exists because the overlay route had never been executed - the overlay was validated, resolved and hash-pinned as a document, so the claim that a run shows an added node rested on the resolver's output and on no state file at all. deep-review is the node the overlay adds; it is completed, and it sits last, after the completion node its needs names. workflow.overlays records the overlay the run was frozen with, and graph_hash is the overlay route's own pinned hash, so a rename in the built-in moves the hash and this file stops agreeing with the definition it names.
